name: Nogg's Ring Redo
summary: In Orgrimmar, Nogg seeks to improve a ring brought from Gnomeregan. He wants rare materials and word of the Dark Iron dwarves, hoping to prove goblin craft finer than gnomish design.

sections.title: Goblin Superiority
sections.body: You carry a cleaned gold ring from Gnomeregan to Nogg's workshop in the Valley of Honor. The goblin engineer studies its plain gnomish work and offers a bargain. Bring him raw materials and a small fee, and he will frame the band with silver and moss agate. The lattice is meant to strengthen the magic within.

sections.title: A Dwarven Angle
sections.body: Nogg's offer reaches beyond trade. He has heard that Dark Iron dwarves are inside the besieged gnome city. Their presence may explain the sudden leaps in mechanical skill among gnomes, a craft goblins claim as their own. Your information brings an improved ring and Nogg's grudging respect.

faq.answer: Nogg is a goblin engineer in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He works with fellow tinkerers in the Drag and Valley of Honor, examining curious mechanical artifacts and schematics brought back from dangerous expeditions.

faq.q: What materials are needed to reforge the ring?
faq.answer: Nogg asks for the original Brilliant Gold Ring, one Silver Bar, one Moss Agate, and thirty silver coins to cover his work and workshop expenses.

faq.q: Why is Nogg interested in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Gnomeregan holds great technological value. Goblins compete fiercely with gnomes in technical fields, and Nogg wonders if Dark Iron dwarves were involved in the technological anomalies inside the fallen techno-city.

faq.q: What does Nogg actually do to the ring?
faq.answer: Nogg builds a lattice of silver and moss agate around the gold band. The framework channels and steadies the ring's enchantments, making it stronger than the original gnomish design.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain start?
faq.answer: The chain begins deep in Gnomeregan. You find a Grime-Encrusted Ring on a Dark Iron dwarf, then clean it with the Sparklematic 5200 machine.

faq.q: Why does Nogg suspect Dark Iron dwarves?
faq.answer: Goblin engineers distrust gnomish innovation. Nogg suspects outside meddling behind any sudden leap in gnomish mechanical skill, especially by the scheming Dark Iron clan.

angles.text: As an engineer, you see the rivalry between goblin ingenuity and gnomish gadgetry. Goblins alter existing devices boldly to get the most from them.
As a member of the Horde, you can bring technology from Alliance-aligned halls like Gnomeregan to Orgrimmar's tinkerers. That gives the Horde insight into its enemies' capabilities.
As a miner, you can help supply Nogg with a refined silver bar and a moss agate, gathered through mining and gem-cutting.
